expert.name: Eleni
expert.quote: Mykonos for the nights and Santorini for the light. Give each island three nights and you will never feel rushed.
expert.tip: Book your Santorini hotel on the caldera rim in Imerovigli rather than Oia. Same sunset, half the crowd, and you can walk to Oia along the cliff path.

summary: Nine days island hopping from Athens: the Acropolis and its museum, two nights on Mykonos for the old town and the bays, three on the Santorini caldera with the volcano and the cliff villages, then a last night on the mainland.
included: Included: 3 nights in Athens, 2 nights on Mykonos and 3 nights on Santorini with breakfast; private airport and port transfers; ferry tickets between the islands; all sightseeing as listed with entrance fees where stated; daily breakfast; a guided Athens city tour with the Acropolis Museum; a Mykonos sightseeing tour; the Santorini volcano and hot springs cruise.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Schengen visa fees; lunches and dinners unless stated; travel insurance; optional excursions; personal expenses. Hotels are named on confirmation: the operator quotes a standard class rather than fixed properties.
